componentPanel.directionalityLowTooltip: This environment is close to uniformly lit. The ambient term is usable, but the key light direction is not meaningful.
componentPanel.shCoefficientTooltipFmt:
%s
%+.4f  %+.4f  %+.4f

Swatch is |value| relative to the largest coefficient, so it shows magnitude and hue only - the sign is in the numbers. Negative coefficients are normal for the l=1 and l=2 bands.

depthMeshCapture.arucoAutoCalibrateNote: If one of the project's ArUco markers is visible in the frame, it is used to calibrate the metric scale automatically.
depthMeshCapture.cameraIntrinsicsUnresolved: Could not resolve the camera intrinsics. Is the camera calibrated?
depthMeshCapture.cameraPoseUnresolved: Could not resolve the camera pose. Is the camera tracked?
depthMeshCapture.cpuWarning: Running on CPU - expect ~10 seconds rather than ~1.
depthMeshCapture.culledCellsFmt: %d cells cut at depth discontinuities (expected along silhouettes - the mesh separates rather than stretching skirts between surfaces).
depthMeshCapture.frameSceneInstructions: Frame the part of the scene the composited character will interact with - the floor and nearby surfaces that should catch its shadow. Thin structures and transparent surfaces reconstruct poorly.
depthMeshCapture.inferenceFailed: Depth inference failed. See MikanCmd.log for details.
depthMeshCapture.markerCornerDisagreement: The marker corners disagree on the factor - the marker may be at a grazing angle or on a depth edge. Reposition it and redo.
depthMeshCapture.meshGenerationFailed: Mesh generation produced no usable geometry.
depthMeshCapture.meshWriteFailedFmt: Failed to write the mesh to '%s'.
depthMeshCapture.modelLoadFailedFmt: Could not load the MoGe-2 model from '%s'. Run tools/fetch_moge2_onnx.py to download it. See MikanCmd.log for details.
depthMeshCapture.noProjectLoaded: No project is loaded, so there is nowhere to save the mesh.
depthMeshCapture.noScaleCalibrationExplanation: Metric scale is the model's raw guess and can be off by a large factor. Place an ArUco marker of known size in view and redo to calibrate.
depthMeshCapture.noUndistortedFrame: No undistorted color frame was available from the video source.
depthMeshCapture.previewOverlayNote: The overlay colors the recovered depth (red = near, blue = far). Check that color edges hug the object silhouettes in the frame before applying.
depthMeshCapture.scaleCorrectionSavedFmt: Scale correction %.3f was saved to the camera and will apply to future captures without a marker in view.
depthMeshCapture.scaleFactorSavedNote: Creating the stencil saves this factor to the camera for future marker-less captures.
depthMeshCapture.stencilCreateFailed: Failed to create the model stencil.
depthMeshCapture.stencilParentedNote: The stencil is parented under the stage at the capturing camera's pose; connected clients pick it up automatically.
depthMeshCapture.videoStreamStartFailed: Failed to start the video stream.

projectSettings.debugCameraAlignmentTooltip:
Overlays the MR alignment chain: axes at stage origin / puck / aperture,
and a window with live vs calibrated intrinsics, resolution, and offsets.
projectSettings.debugRenderInCompositorTooltip:
Draws the debug overlay above in the compositor output window too.
Off (default): the compositor window shows only the composited shot.
projectSettings.rulerSnapToGridByDefault: Ruler Snap To Grid By Default
projectSettings.rulerSnapTooltip:
Hold Shift while measuring to invert snapping.
Off (default): hold Shift to snap, release to move freely.
projectSettings.spoutLoggingTooltip:
Folds Spout's own diagnostics into the log panel and MikanXR.log.
Off (default): Spout logging is disabled entirely, and no Spout console window opens.
projectSettings.stencilDisplayTooltip: Wireframe hides the opaque mesh so the real model in the video shows through.

sceneLightingCapture.cameraPoseUnresolved: Could not resolve the camera pose. Is the camera tracked?
sceneLightingCapture.cpuWarning: Running on CPU - this will take minutes rather than seconds.
sceneLightingCapture.decomposingShading: Decomposing the frame into diffuse shading...
sceneLightingCapture.estimationFailedSeeLog: Lighting estimation failed. See MikanCmd.log for details.
sceneLightingCapture.frameSceneInstructions: Frame a view of the scene that shows a good spread of surface orientations - floor, walls and objects. Flat views of a single wall cannot constrain the lighting.
sceneLightingCapture.loadingModels: Loading the lighting and geometry models...
sceneLightingCapture.modelLoadFailedFmt: Could not load the models from '%s' and '%s'. Run tools/export_marigold_onnx.py and tools/fetch_moge2_onnx.py to produce them. See MikanCmd.log for details.
sceneLightingCapture.nearAmbientExplanation: This scene is close to uniformly lit. The ambient term is usable, but the key light direction is not meaningful and should not be used to place a directional light.
sceneLightingCapture.negativeRadianceFmt: Negative radiance over %.0f%% of the sphere. This is expected for directional scenes - order-2 spherical harmonics cannot represent a sharp light - and is clamped when the environment is used.
sceneLightingCapture.noCastShadowsNote: Cast shadows are absent by construction - an environment probe has no visibility term. Judge the direction and color of the shading, not the shadows.
sceneLightingCapture.noUndistortedFrame: No undistorted color frame was available from the video source.
sceneLightingCapture.previewLitSphereExplanation: A sphere lit by the recovered environment, in camera space.
sceneLightingCapture.previewModelShadingExplanation: The diffuse shading the fit solved against. Its cast shadows are the part an environment probe cannot reproduce.
sceneLightingCapture.previewRecoveredLightingExplanation: The recovered environment evaluated at the scene's own normals. Compare against 'Model shading' - where they agree, the estimate explains the lighting.
sceneLightingCapture.previewRelitSceneExplanation: The plate re-rendered with only the recovered lighting. It should read like the real frame, minus cast shadows.
sceneLightingCapture.videoStreamStartFailed: Failed to start the video stream.
